description: How many gallons of rainwater your roof can collect from a storm, a month or a year of rain, how many rain barrels that fills, and how much to divert as first flush, using the Texas Manual on Rainwater Harvesting method. Formula: Gallons = rainfall (in) × roof footprint (sq ft) × 0.62 × efficiency. Barrels = gallons ÷ barrel size, rounded up. First flush = roof ÷ 1,000 × 10 gal.

first_flush_gal_per_1000.description: First-flush diversion (gal per 1,000 sq ft); default 10

name: calc_rainwater_harvesting
title: Rainwater Harvesting Calculator (Gallons from Your Roof)
